answer_2.quote: In the RTW-AV, we introduced two metrics for the presentation of results in the RTW-AV, namely Time-Delayed Accuracy (TDA) and Context Utilization Score (CUS) ... In ECVE, two metrics have been introduced in the ECVE: Entity-Independent Accuracy (EIA) and Bias Reduction Ratio (BRR). ... For the presentation of the final results of the whole TripleFact framework, we use the TripleFact Score (TFS).
